readme: Every URL of the old Site123 site. "destination" defaults to the same path, so if the Astro site keeps the same paths nothing is lost. If you rename a page, change its destination and set needs_redirect to true. "astro" is ready to paste into the redirects field of astro.config.mjs (only entries that need a redirect). Updated for the Hebrew-to-English URL migration (2026-10): every old Hebrew path now 301s to its new English path (/שירותים→/services, /עבודות→/work, /אודות→/about, /בין-לקוחותינו→/clients, /במספרים→/numbers, /צרו-קשר→/contact; portfolio items moved from /עבודות/* to /work/*).

redirects.note: Source has a query string; Astro static redirects match paths only, so the path-only form is listed too.
